notes: Inspiria, editor samplu: značka K sa pri slučke chytala na mieste slučky – opravené; slučka ostáva vždy medzi Z a K; prekryté značky: hore sa chytá Z/K, dole L. Ukazovateľ prehrávania (Inspiria aj Sampler) beží len kým držíš kláves.
notes_en: Inspiria sample editor: with a loop the K marker was grabbed at the loop position – fixed; the loop always stays between Z and K; overlapping markers: Z/K at the top, L at the bottom. The playback cursor (Inspiria and Sampler) runs only while you hold the key.
